title: Single-cell RNA-Seq Expression Analysis
author: John J. Trombetta
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pbidike
materials: Under the “Recipes” drop-down menu on the GenomeSpace interface, select “Analyzing data with GenomeSpace tools”.

steps.title: Prepare Analysis Environment
steps.instruction: Choose between using GenomeSpace or a Unix command line for expression analysis.

steps.title: Upload Raw Data
steps.instruction: Upload each of the raw FASTQ files from the sequencing run into the home directory of the GenomeSpace interface via drag-and-drop.

steps.title: Configure GenomeSpace Pipeline
steps.instruction: Select the appropriate application for data analysis and follow the instructions to generate an analysis pipeline using the available GenomeSpace tools.

steps.title: Install Required Software
steps.instruction: Ensure the following programs are installed and ready on the computer or server: TopHat, Bowtie (or Bowtie2), Samtools, Picard tools, Integrative Genomics Viewer (IGV), and Cufflinks.

steps.title: Align Reads with TopHat
steps.instruction: Run TopHat to match paired-end reads with their mates and align them to the desired reference genome to generate the ~/accepted_hits.bam file.

substeps.instruction: Provide Left reads FASTQ file (compressed or uncompressed)
Provide Right reads FASTQ file (compressed or uncompressed)

steps.title: Analyze Sequencing Quality with Picard
steps.instruction: Use the Picard suite of command-line tools on the ~/accepted_hits.bam file to analyze sequencing quality.

substeps.instruction: Run CollectAlignmentSummaryMetrics.jar to view statistics on reads correctly aligned to the reference genome: % java –jar ~/picard/CollectAlignmentSummaryMetrics.jar [options] I=~/accepted_hits.bam O=~/AlignmentMetrics.txt

Run CollectInsertSizeMetrics.jar to view statistics on sequenced cDNA fragment lengths: % java –jar ~/picard/CollectInsertSizeMetrics.jar [options] H=~/InsertSizeHistogramChart.txt I=~/accepted_hits/bam

steps.title: Sort BAM File
steps.instruction: Organize the BAM file data based on aligned reads' locations in the reference genome using Picard SortSam.jar.

substeps.instruction: Execute command: % java –jar ~/picard/SortSam.jar I=~/accepted_hits.bam O=~/accepted_hits.sort.bam SO=coordinate

steps.title: Index Sorted BAM File
steps.instruction: Index the sorted BAM file using the Samtools suite of command-line tools.

steps.title: Visualize Data in IGV
steps.instruction: Perform graphical visualization of the aligned sequencing reads using the Integrative Genomics Viewer (IGV).

steps.title: Quantify Gene Expression with Cufflinks
steps.instruction: Run Cufflinks on the ~/accepted_hits.sort.bam file to obtain quantitative measures of gene or transcript abundance in fragments per kilobase of exon per million mapped fragments (FPKM).
